summary: Tested Super Admin Dashboard for chess coaching app. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified: Admin nav link visibility for admin users, Overview tab with platform stats, Users tab with search/filter/create, User detail view with games/analyses/habits, Feedback queue with status/source filters and expand/collapse.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend admin endpoints properly protected with require_admin and require_super_admin dependencies
Role-based access control working: super_admin can create users and change roles, admin can view
Feedback flag endpoint correctly stores user feedback with source (lab/coach), FEN, move info
Frontend AdminDashboard.jsx properly checks user.role for access control
FlagMoveButton component integrated into V5CoachingCard for both Lab and Coach views
Layout.jsx shows Admin nav link only for admin/super_admin users
seed_data_creation: Created test users and feedback items during testing (prefixed with test_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin Dashboard fully tested. Backend APIs: GET /api/admin/overview (platform stats), GET /api/admin/users (list with search/filter), GET /api/admin/users/{id} (detail with games/habits/progress), POST /api/admin/users (create - super_admin only), PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/role (change role - super_admin only), POST /api/feedback/flag (submit feedback), GET /api/admin/feedback (list with status/source filters), PATCH /api/admin/feedback/{id} (update status). Frontend: Admin nav at /admin visible for admin users, three tabs (Overview/Users/Feedback), user detail drill-down, create user dialog, feedback expand/collapse with action buttons. Dev user (user_62852a1b64e7, Mohit Maheshwari) has role=super_admin.

GET /api/admin/overview.returns: total_users, active_7d, active_30d, total_games, total_analyses, community_positions, feedback_pending, feedback_total, recent_users

GET /api/admin/users.returns: users list with game_count and role, supports search and role filter

GET /api/admin/users/{user_id}.returns: user details, game_count, analysis_count, opening_progress, habits, recent_games, feedback

POST /api/admin/users.creates: new user with name, email, rating, role

POST /api/feedback/flag.accepts: source (lab/coach), game_id, session_id, move_number, fen, move_san, coaching_text, user_note

GET /api/admin/feedback.returns: feedback list with total and pending counts, supports status and source filters

overview_tab.shows: 8 stat cards (Total Users, Active 7d/30d, Total Games, Analyses, Community Pool, Feedback Pending/Total), Recent Signups list

features: user rows with game count and role badges

user_detail_view.shows: user info, stats (Games/Analyses/Rating/Joined), Recent Games list, Opening Progress, role change select (super_admin)

create_user_dialog.validation: Submit button disabled when name/email empty
